name: Laraguard MCP
description: A security audit server for Laravel projects that performs static code analysis, dependency CVE checks, and configuration audits. It enables developers to detect vulnerabilities like SQL injection and XSS while providing active attack simulations directly within MCP-compatible IDEs.

rawRecord.description: A security audit server for Laravel projects that performs static code analysis, dependency CVE checks, and configuration audits. It enables developers to detect vulnerabilities like SQL injection and XSS while providing active attack simulations directly within MCP-compatible IDEs.

MCP_BASE_PATH.description: Single allowed root path for project scanning.

MCP_MAX_FILES.description: Maximum number of files to enumerate per scan.

MCP_BASE_PATHS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed root paths. Takes precedence over MCP_BASE_PATH.

MCP_MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES.description: Maximum file size (in bytes) to read per file.
